name: @weavetab/plugin-github
description: Official Weavetab GitHub plugin. Modular tools to analyze repositories, read raw source files, search issues, inspect pull requests, fetch raw diffs, and inspect active tabs directly without burning browser turns or API quota.

config.reason: Reads and persists plugin configuration (cache TTL, read limits, issue limits, optional token) at ~/.weavetab/plugins/@weavetab_plugin-github/config.json.

cdp.reason: Evaluates active tab URL and DOM on github.com to infer targets or inspect active views without API calls.

network.reason: Fetches repository metadata, file trees, raw source files, issues, pull requests, and raw git diffs from GitHub REST API, CDN, and web endpoints.

tools.reason: Registers github_analyze, github_read, github_issues, github_pull_request, github_diff, and github_active_tab MCP tools.

tools.name: github_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a GitHub repository's metadata, default branch, recursive file tree, and README snippet over the GitHub REST API without burning browser turns.

repo.description: Target repository as 'owner/repo' or full github.com URL. When omitted, inferred from the active browser tab.

tools.name: github_read
tools.description: Fetch raw source files from a GitHub repository directly over HTTP without burning browser turns or API search quota.

paths.description: File paths relative to the repository root, e.g. ['src/index.ts', 'README.md'].

repo.description: Target repository as 'owner/repo' or full github.com URL. When omitted, inferred from active tab.

branch.description: Target branch or tag (defaults to 'main' or cached default branch). Avoids API discovery calls.

line_range.description: Optional [start, end] 1-indexed line range to return per file.

tools.name: github_issues
tools.description: List, search, or inspect issues and comments in a GitHub repository without burning browser turns.

repo.description: Target repository as 'owner/repo' or full github.com URL.

number.description: Specific issue number to fetch full details and timeline comments for.

search.description: Free-text query to search issues in the repository.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default 5).

tools.name: github_pull_request
tools.description: Examine pull request details, changed files, diff stats, and comments, or list recent pull requests in a GitHub repository without burning browser turns.

repo.description: Target repository as 'owner/repo' or full github.com URL.

number.description: Pull request number to fetch full detail, changed files, and comments for.

state.description: Filter pull requests by state (default 'all' when listing).

limit.description: Maximum pull requests to return when listing (default 10).

tools.name: github_diff
tools.description: Fetch raw git diffs or patches for pull requests, commits, or branch comparisons directly from github.com without consuming REST API rate limits.

repo.description: Target repository as 'owner/repo' or full github.com URL.

pull_number.description: Pull request number to fetch the diff or patch for.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA to fetch the diff or patch for.

base.description: Base branch or commit for compare diff (requires 'head').

head.description: Head branch or commit for compare diff (requires 'base').

format.description: Output format: 'diff' (unified diff) or 'patch' (git patch with metadata). Default 'diff'.

tools.name: github_active_tab
tools.description: Inspect the active browser tab on github.com via local CDP evaluation. Extracts repository overview, open PR/issue discussion, or file content directly from the browser DOM with ZERO API calls. Works on private repositories you are logged into.

scope.description: Scope of data extraction from the page DOM (default 'auto').
